evidence.detail: The class extends vertical JToolBar, is non-floatable, and has exact 36x503 base dimensions.
It maintains a sorted Map<NavigationButton, Component>; add/remove operations rebuild the visible toolbar from that map.
Navigation buttons are ordered by their toolbar-section flag, priority and title; the rebuild inserts glue/separator between the two button groups.
R147 ClientUI adds ordinary NavigationButton components to this toolbar on NavigationButtonAdded and removes them on NavigationButtonRemoved.

proposals.note: ClientToolbar is fixed by its vertical NavigationButton toolbar shape and direct ClientUI navigation-event ownership. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The class is a final JPanel whose constructor accepts the game Applet/Client component and adds it at BorderLayout.CENTER.
It fixes size, minimum size and preferred size to exact 765x503 client dimensions and uses a black background.
R147 ClientUI constructs this panel directly around its live rs/Client instance before embedding it in the main window layout.

proposals.note: ClientPanel is fixed by exclusive wrapping of the live game client at exact 765x503 dimensions inside ClientUI. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The class extends JPanel and provides the shared 350/367-pixel plugin-panel layout, border, scroll pane and inner content panel used by client plugins.
R12 NavigationButton stores an optional rs/ui/m panel; R147 ClientUI installs that panel in its CardLayout under the NavigationButton title.
The base exposes paired lifecycle hooks J_()/K_(); ClientUI invokes them when activating and deactivating the currently displayed navigation panel.
The class exposes the scroll pane to subclasses and the inner JPanel to ClientUI for sizing and card-container installation.

proposals.note: PluginPanel is fixed by its shared plugin-side-panel layout plus NavigationButton ownership and ClientUI activation/deactivation lifecycle. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: R147 ClientUI installs this panel into the window title pane as a trailing extra component when custom/undecorated window decoration is active.
The class maintains a sorted Map<NavigationButton, Component> and rebuilds itself on button add/remove.
ClientUI routes NavigationButtons flagged for the title area into this panel while routing ordinary buttons into ClientToolbar.
Components are ordered by NavigationButton priority and title, matching the top/title navigation role.

proposals.note: ClientTitleToolbar is fixed by direct title-pane placement and the exact NavigationButton subset routed into it by ClientUI. Confidence is 0.999.
